payload.content: A sustainable-energy WordPress website helping homeowners compare solar panels, inverters, charging and storage solutions before requesting postcode-based advice or a quotation.
payload.description_1: The current offer is centred on energy products and package combinations, not roof construction. Visitors need to compare generation, storage, charging and inverter choices without being led into a roof-and-solar decision that the live service structure no longer reflects.
payload.description_2: I structured the journey around individual energy solutions and the available package combinations. Product routes explain solar panels, inverters, charging and storage first, while postcode-based advice and quotation actions provide the next step without treating projected savings, payback or installation timing as portfolio results.
